title: NTR Hunter
description:
Take on the role of Norihito in collecting debts! It's a boring job, but it introduced you to your loving wife. That being said, not everyone will be thrilled to have their pockets pilfered by your company. At least your wife, Hisako, will always be there to support you.

With talks of a promotion on the horizon, it's a great time to try to please the boss, but things quickly take a turn for the worse as you end up getting mugged and left unconscious. Millions have been stolen from you, yet your boss lets you off the hook without consequences. In the meantime, your wife has started to behave oddly, and you suspect she's hiding something.

It falls to you to uncover what secrets Hisako is keeping from you. Other forces, however, do not like your interference and are sure to retaliate, all while the mysterious spirit takes a growing interest in the drama unfolding before you...

How far will you go to protect Hisako, before you lose her forever?

 

In this NTR RPG, take on the role of a debt collector, Norihito. Explore, collect money, and investigate your wife's odd behaviour. To collect money, you'll need quick reflexes to shake down the debtors through mini-games, or you can try fishing if you want a break from your job. Use your special powers, granted by the NTR Spirit, to investigate your wife's strange behaviour, in hopes of uncovering the affairs leading your relationship down the uncertain path, and steering it towards the one your desire.

Spiritual Powers Harness the power of the Spirit of NTR to see what others cannot! Be it a peek of what Hisako is doing at the moment, X-ray Vision, or even a Spirit Form in which you are intangible and invisible, use whatever means are at your disposal to pry into Hisako and your boss's affairs.

Live2D Animated Scenes with Voice Acting All errotic scenes are animated using Live2D animation.

Secrets Scattered across the town, there are many events, items, interactions, and costumes that may become missable until after the game ends if one isn't diligent in searching for them.

Mini games Spend some time catching fish to make a bit of extra cash! If you're exceptionally lucky, you might catch a few items to fuel your spiritual powers or even a sexy outfit for Hisako.

Multiple Outfits to unlockEither found through exploration or purchased at the shops, several outfits can be obtained for Hisako to wear during previously seen events or while checking Hisako's status.

Multiple EndingsBased on your choices throughout the game, you can discover one of multiple routes for Hisako to follow, with or without you.

Post-game Spirit Realm In the Spirit realm, money offerings are more than welcome as the NTR Spirit is willing to unlock all of the scenes in the game, including ones you had missed, for a price.

Easy gameplay Either using the mouse or keyboard, traversal and actions are simple, often only requiring one hand to perform them.
description_short: In this NTR RPG, play as Norihito, a debt collector investigating his wife Hisako’s strange behavior. Earn money through mini-games and use your newly acquired special powers to spy on your wife's secret affairs with your boss. Can you protect Hisako, or will you let another man steal her from you?
